sources.description: The Denver Broncos lost the game in two of three phases on Monday – offensively and defensively. I would say that special teams was the only phase that the Broncos won. Jeremy Crawshaw forced the Kansas City Chiefs to start three drives inside their 10 (9, 6 and 3 yard lines). The Broncos only started […]
